Rules / Maintainability

SK7040 TODO or FIXME has no issue reference

An actionable comment has no durable place where its owner, context and completion can be tracked.

CategoryMaintainability
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

A TODO in source is discovered only by someone who happens to open that line. An issue can be assigned, discussed, searched and closed; the comment remains useful as the local pointer to it. The rule accepts a URL, #123, or a project key such as SKALA-123 and does not attempt to invent an issue or remove the comment.

Example

Instead of:

// TODO: handle cancellation

Write:

// TODO SKALA-123: handle cancellation

When it does not fire

Some repositories deliberately use source comments as their backlog. Those projects should disable the rule. Only TODO/FIXME markers at the start of a comment line are actionable, so prose that merely discusses those words and strings containing them are ignored. A marker carrying a URL, hash-number or conventional project issue key is accepted.

Configuration

  • dotnet_diagnostic.SK7040.severity
